user.title: Connect to Kameraposti
user.description: Choose the service and enter your Kameraposti account number and the MQTT password from Kameraposti's Sensors page (Kamerat → Sensors → MQTT). The login is kp-<account number>.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Kameraposti
reauth_confirm.description: Kameraposti rejected the stored password. Create or change the MQTT password on Kameraposti's Sensors page and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kameraposti broker. Check your network connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Kameraposti rejected these credentials. Check the account number and the MQTT password.

abort.already_configured: This Kameraposti account is already configured.
